title: Preserve sounding and display transposition separately
scope: Retain staff sounding/display offsets and their effect on pitch and key through GPIF import, public edits and GP8 export.
acceptance: Reproduce upstream guitarpro8/e.gp: Chromatic=4 must not disappear or reset its effective key from four flats to zero.
Test positive/negative chromatic offsets, octave shifts, transposing instruments and differing staff offsets.
Keep concert pitch, displayed pitch and string/fret authority explicit; validate checked boundaries and compare exact consumer values.
exclusions: The separate lowercase key-mode bug is not part of this fix.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].displayTranspositionPitch. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
